newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market very slow -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market very slow -USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle on Wednesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales confirmed on 100 head slaughter heifers; 21,200 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,700 head formulated and 400 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 67.00.
Wk to Date- 21,200 Week Ago - 69,500 Year Ago - 104,100
